The Banach–Mazur upper sandwich follows directly from the norm inequalities.

value.rationale: The ray is canonically tied to the cube by adding an l1 term to the l-infinity gauge, and it directly tests a proposed quadratic stability envelope. The exact linear slope and explicit envelope refutation identify a genuine boundary phenomenon rather than an arbitrary sample. This is a motivated structural counterexample/calibration datum despite not proving a global stability theorem.
risks: Its value is directional and diagnostic; it should not be advertised as a uniform Mahler-stability constant.
